## Three nested ideas

- **Artificial intelligence (AI)** is the broad goal: computers performing tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language or recognising images.
- **Machine learning (ML)** is one way to achieve it: instead of writing every rule by hand, we show a computer many examples and it *learns patterns* from them.
- **Deep learning** is a kind of machine learning that uses large **neural networks** — layered mathematical models loosely inspired by the brain.

## Learning from examples

A spam filter is a classic example. Nobody writes a rule for every possible spam message. Instead, the system sees millions of emails labelled “spam” or “not spam” and learns which patterns usually mean spam.

## What AI is not

> [!WARNING]
> Today’s AI systems do not *understand* the world the way people do, and they have no intentions. They produce outputs based on patterns in their training data. That makes them powerful — and capable of confident mistakes.

## Where you already meet AI

Photo search on your phone, voice assistants, translation apps, recommendations on video platforms, and chat assistants that can write and explain text.

uz.body_md:
## Bir-birining ichidagi uchta tushuncha

- **Sunʼiy intellekt (SI, inglizcha *AI*)** — keng maqsad: odatda inson aql-zakovatini talab qiladigan vazifalarni, masalan, tilni tushunish yoki tasvirlarni tanib olishni kompyuterlar bajarishi.
- **Mashinali oʻqitish** (*machine learning, ML*) — bu maqsadga erishish yoʻllaridan biri: har bir qoidani qoʻlda yozish oʻrniga kompyuterga koʻplab misollar koʻrsatiladi va u ulardan *qonuniyatlarni oʻrganadi*.
- **Chuqur oʻqitish** (*deep learning*) — katta **neyron tarmoqlar**dan, yaʼni miyadan qisman ilhomlangan koʻp qatlamli matematik modellardan foydalanadigan mashinali oʻqitish turi.

## Misollardan oʻrganish

Spam filtri — klassik misol. Hech kim har bir spam xat uchun alohida qoida yozmaydi. Buning oʻrniga tizim “spam” yoki “spam emas” deb belgilangan millionlab xatlarni koʻradi va qaysi qonuniyatlar odatda spamni bildirishini oʻrganadi.

## Sunʼiy intellekt nima emas

> [!WARNING]
> Bugungi sunʼiy intellekt tizimlari dunyoni odamlar kabi *tushunmaydi* va ularning niyatlari yoʻq. Ular oʻqitish maʼlumotlaridagi qonuniyatlar asosida javob hosil qiladi. Bu ularni kuchli qiladi — va ishonch bilan xato qilishga ham qodir qiladi.

## Sunʼiy intellektga allaqachon qayerda duch kelasiz

Telefoningizdagi suratlar boʻyicha qidiruv, ovozli yordamchilar, tarjima ilovalari, video platformalardagi tavsiyalar hamda matn yozib bera oladigan va tushuntira oladigan chat-yordamchilar.

contents.body_md:
## Predicting the next piece of text

A **large language model (LLM)** is trained on a huge amount of text. Its core skill is surprisingly simple to state: given some text, **predict what comes next**.

Text is split into small pieces called **tokens** — whole words, parts of words or punctuation. The model repeatedly predicts the next token, adds it, and predicts again. Because it learned from so much writing, those predictions can form explanations, summaries, code and translations.

## Why this matters for you

- **Context is everything.** The model only knows what is in its training and what you put in the conversation. Give it the background it needs.
- **It can be wrong, fluently.** When a model produces believable but false information, this is called a **hallucination**.
- **It has a knowledge cut-off.** Unless connected to search or documents, it may not know recent events.

> [!TIP]
> Treat AI output like a draft from a fast, well-read assistant: useful, but **verify facts, numbers, quotes and sources** before you rely on them.

uz.body_md:
## Matnning keyingi boʻlagini bashorat qilish

**Katta til modeli** (*large language model, LLM*) ulkan hajmdagi matnlar asosida oʻqitiladi. Uning asosiy mahoratini taʼriflash hayratlanarli darajada oson: berilgan matndan keyin **nima kelishini bashorat qilish**.

Matn **token** deb ataladigan kichik boʻlaklarga — butun soʻzlar, soʻz qismlari yoki tinish belgilariga ajratiladi. Model navbatdagi tokenni bashorat qiladi, uni matnga qoʻshadi va yana bashorat qiladi. U juda koʻp yozma matndan oʻrgangani uchun bu bashoratlar tushuntirishlar, qisqacha bayonlar, kod va tarjimalarni hosil qila oladi.

## Bu siz uchun nima uchun muhim

- **Kontekst — hamma narsa.** Model faqat oʻqitilganda koʻrgan narsalarni va siz suhbatga kiritgan maʼlumotni biladi. Unga kerakli maʼlumotni bering.
- **U ravon tarzda xato qilishi mumkin.** Model ishonarli, ammo yolgʻon maʼlumot hosil qilsa, bu **gallyutsinatsiya** deyiladi.
- **Uning bilimlari maʼlum sanagacha.** Agar qidiruv tizimi yoki hujjatlarga ulanmagan boʻlsa, u soʻnggi voqealardan bexabar boʻlishi mumkin.

> [!TIP]
> Sunʼiy intellekt javobiga tez ishlaydigan va koʻp oʻqigan yordamchining qoralamasi sifatida qarang: foydali, ammo unga tayanishdan oldin **faktlar, raqamlar, iqtiboslar va manbalarni tekshiring**.

contents.body_md:
## From vague to precise

A vague prompt gets a generic answer:

> Write about Samarkand.

A structured prompt gets a useful one. Include these five parts:

1. **Role** — who should the assistant act as? *“You are a friendly history teacher.”*
2. **Context** — the background. *“My students are 14 and have never studied the Silk Road.”*
3. **Task** — exactly what you want. *“Explain why Samarkand became an important city.”*
4. **Constraints** — limits. *“Under 200 words, simple vocabulary, no dates except centuries.”*
5. **Format** — the shape of the answer. *“Three short paragraphs, then one question for discussion.”*

## Iterate

Your first prompt is a starting point. If the answer is too long, too formal or misses something, say so: *“Shorter, and add one example a teenager would relate to.”*

## Practice

Rewrite this weak prompt using all five parts, then try it with any AI assistant you have access to:

> Help me with my CV.

> [!NOTE]
> Never paste passwords, private documents or other people’s personal data into an AI tool unless you know exactly how that tool stores and uses it.

uz.body_md:
## Noaniqdan aniqqa

Noaniq prompt umumiy javob oladi:

> Samarqand haqida yozib ber.

Tuzilmali prompt esa foydali javob oladi. Unga quyidagi beshta qismni kiriting:

1. **Rol** — yordamchi kim sifatida ish tutsin? *“Sen samimiy tarix oʻqituvchisisan.”*
2. **Kontekst** — vaziyat haqida maʼlumot. *“Oʻquvchilarim 14 yoshda va Buyuk Ipak yoʻlini hali oʻrganishmagan.”*
3. **Vazifa** — aynan nima kerakligi. *“Samarqand nima uchun muhim shaharga aylanganini tushuntir.”*
4. **Cheklovlar** — chegaralar. *“200 soʻzdan kam, oddiy soʻzlar bilan, asrlardan boshqa sanalarni keltirma.”*
5. **Format** — javobning shakli. *“Uchta qisqa xatboshi, soʻngra muhokama uchun bitta savol.”*

## Takomillashtiring

Birinchi promptingiz — faqat boshlangʻich nuqta. Javob juda uzun, haddan tashqari rasmiy boʻlsa yoki biror narsa yetishmasa, buni ayting: *“Qisqaroq yoz va oʻsmir oʻziga yaqin oladigan bitta misol qoʻsh.”*

## Mashq

Quyidagi zaif promptni beshta qismning hammasidan foydalanib qayta yozing, soʻngra uni oʻzingizda bor istalgan sunʼiy intellekt yordamchisida sinab koʻring:

> Rezyumemni yozishga yordam ber.

> [!NOTE]
> Vosita maʼlumotlarni qanday saqlashi va ishlatishini aniq bilmasangiz, unga hech qachon parollar, maxfiy hujjatlar yoki boshqa odamlarning shaxsiy maʼlumotlarini kiritmang.

contents.body_md:
## Install

1. Go to **blender.org** and open the **Download** page.
2. Download the version for your system (Windows, macOS — choose Apple Silicon or Intel — or Linux).
3. Run the installer, then open Blender.

> [!WARNING]
> Download Blender only from blender.org (or official stores such as Steam and the Microsoft Store). It is free — any site asking for payment is not official.

## The default scene

Blender opens with a **cube**, a **camera** and a **light**. This is the default scene, ready for you to experiment.

## The five main areas

1. **3D Viewport** — the large central area where you see and edit your scene.
2. **Outliner** (top right) — a list of every object in the scene, like a table of contents.
3. **Properties Editor** (bottom right) — settings for the selected object, its material, the render and more, organised in tabs.
4. **Timeline** (bottom) — controls for animation over time.
5. **Toolbar** (left of the viewport) — tools such as Select, Move, Rotate and Scale.

Across the top are **workspaces** (Layout, Modeling, Sculpting, Shading…). Each is a pre-arranged set of areas for a particular job.

> [!TIP]
> Hover over almost any button and wait — Blender shows a tooltip explaining what it does.

uz.body_md:
## Oʻrnatish

1. **blender.org** saytiga kiring va **Download** sahifasini oching.
2. Tizimingizga mos versiyani yuklab oling (Windows, macOS — Apple Silicon yoki Intel protsessorli variantni tanlang — yoki Linux).
3. Oʻrnatuvchini ishga tushiring, soʻngra Blenderni oching.

> [!WARNING]
> Blenderni faqat blender.org saytidan (yoki Steam va Microsoft Store kabi rasmiy doʻkonlardan) yuklab oling. U bepul — toʻlov soʻraydigan har qanday sayt rasmiy emas.

## Standart sahna

Blender **kub**, **kamera** va **yorugʻlik manbai** bilan ochiladi. Bu — tajriba qilishingiz uchun tayyor turgan standart sahna.

## Beshta asosiy qism

1. **3D Viewport** (3D koʻrinish maydoni) — sahnangizni koʻradigan va tahrirlaydigan katta markaziy maydon.
2. **Outliner** (oʻng yuqorida) — sahnadagi barcha obyektlar roʻyxati, xuddi mundarija kabi.
3. **Properties Editor** (xususiyatlar paneli, oʻng pastda) — tanlangan obyekt, uning materiali, render va boshqalar uchun sozlamalar; ular yorliqlarga ajratilgan.
4. **Timeline** (vaqt shkalasi, pastda) — vaqt boʻyicha animatsiyani boshqarish.
5. **Toolbar** (asboblar paneli, koʻrinish maydonining chap tomonida) — Select, Move, Rotate va Scale kabi asboblar.

Yuqori qismda **ish maydonlari** (*workspaces*: Layout, Modeling, Sculpting, Shading…) joylashgan. Ularning har biri muayyan ish uchun oldindan tayyorlangan oynalar toʻplami.

> [!TIP]
> Deyarli istalgan tugma ustiga kursorni olib borib, biroz kuting — Blender u nima qilishini tushuntiruvchi qisqa izoh koʻrsatadi.

contents.body_md:
## The three moves

| Action | Mouse | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Orbit** | Hold **middle mouse button** and drag | Rotates your view around the scene |
| **Pan** | **Shift** + middle mouse drag | Slides your view sideways |
| **Zoom** | Scroll the wheel | Moves closer or further away |

## Useful views (numeric keypad)

- **1** — front, **3** — right side, **7** — top
- **Ctrl** + the same key — the opposite side
- **0** — look through the camera
- **.** (period) on the keypad — frame the selected object

No keypad? Press the **` (backtick)** key for a pie menu of views, or click the axes in the **navigation gizmo** at the top right of the viewport.

> [!TIP]
> Using a laptop without a middle mouse button? Open **Edit → Preferences → Input** and enable **Emulate 3 Button Mouse**. Then **Alt + left-drag** orbits.

## Lost?

Press **Home** to fit everything in view.

uz.body_md:
## Uchta asosiy harakat

| Harakat | Sichqoncha | Nima qiladi |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Orbit** (aylantirish) | **Sichqonchaning oʻrta tugmasini** bosib turib torting | Koʻrinishni sahna atrofida aylantiradi |
| **Pan** (surish) | **Shift** + oʻrta tugmani bosib torting | Koʻrinishni yon tomonga suradi |
| **Zoom** (yaqinlashtirish) | Gʻildirakni aylantiring | Yaqinlashtiradi yoki uzoqlashtiradi |

## Foydali koʻrinishlar (raqamli klaviatura)

- **1** — old tomon, **3** — oʻng tomon, **7** — yuqoridan
- **Ctrl** + oʻsha tugma — qarama-qarshi tomon
- **0** — kamera orqali qarash
- Raqamli klaviaturadagi **.** (nuqta) — tanlangan obyektni ekranga sigʻdirish

Raqamli klaviatura yoʻqmi? Koʻrinishlarning doiraviy menyusini ochish uchun **` (backtick)** tugmasini bosing yoki koʻrinish maydonining oʻng yuqori burchagidagi **navigatsiya gizmosi**dagi oʻqlarni bosing.

> [!TIP]
> Oʻrta tugmasi yoʻq noutbukdan foydalanyapsizmi? **Edit → Preferences → Input** boʻlimini oching va **Emulate 3 Button Mouse** parametrini yoqing. Shundan soʻng **Alt + chap tugma bilan tortish** koʻrinishni aylantiradi.

## Adashib qoldingizmi?

Hamma narsani ekranga sigʻdirish uchun **Home** tugmasini bosing.

contents.body_md:
## Adding objects

Press **Shift + A** in the viewport to open the **Add** menu. Choose **Mesh → UV Sphere**. New objects appear at the **3D cursor** (the red-and-white ring).

## Transforming

Select an object by left-clicking it, then:

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| **G** | Grab (move) |
| **R** | Rotate |
| **S** | Scale |

Move the mouse, then **left-click** to confirm or **right-click** (or Esc) to cancel.

## Constraining to an axis

After pressing G, R or S, press **X**, **Y** or **Z** to limit the change to that axis. You can also type a number:

- **G Z 2** → move 2 metres up
- **R X 90** → rotate 90° around the X axis
- **S 0.5** → scale to half size

## Undo and the sidebar

- **Ctrl + Z** undoes, **Ctrl + Shift + Z** redoes.
- Press **N** to open the **sidebar**, where you can type exact Location, Rotation and Scale values.

## Practice

Delete the default cube (**X → Delete**), then build a simple snowman: three UV spheres of decreasing size stacked along Z, plus a cone for the nose rotated 90° around X.

uz.body_md:
## Obyekt qoʻshish

**Add** menyusini ochish uchun koʻrinish maydonida **Shift + A** tugmalarini bosing. **Mesh → UV Sphere** ni tanlang. Yangi obyektlar **3D kursor** (qizil-oq halqa) turgan joyda paydo boʻladi.

## Transformatsiya

Obyektni sichqonchaning chap tugmasi bilan bosib tanlang, soʻngra:

| Tugma | Amal |
| --- | --- |
| **G** | Grab — siljitish |
| **R** | Rotate — aylantirish |
| **S** | Scale — masshtablash |

Sichqonchani harakatlantiring, keyin tasdiqlash uchun **chap tugmani**, bekor qilish uchun **oʻng tugmani** (yoki Esc) bosing.

## Oʻq boʻyicha cheklash

G, R yoki S tugmasidan keyin oʻzgarishni faqat bitta oʻq boʻyicha cheklash uchun **X**, **Y** yoki **Z** ni bosing. Son ham kiritishingiz mumkin:

- **G Z 2** → 2 metr yuqoriga siljitish
- **R X 90** → X oʻqi atrofida 90° aylantirish
- **S 0.5** → yarim oʻlchamgacha kichraytirish

## Bekor qilish va yon panel

- **Ctrl + Z** amalni bekor qiladi, **Ctrl + Shift + Z** esa qaytaradi.
- **N** tugmasi **yon panel**ni (*sidebar*) ochadi — unda Location (joylashuv), Rotation (burilish) va Scale (masshtab) qiymatlarini aniq kiritish mumkin.

## Mashq

Standart kubni oʻchiring (**X → Delete**), soʻngra oddiy qorbobo yasang: oʻlchami kichrayib boruvchi uchta UV sferani Z oʻqi boʻylab ustma-ust qoʻying va burun uchun X oʻqi atrofida 90° burilgan konus qoʻshing.

contents.body_md:
## Editing is storytelling

**Video editing** is selecting the best moments from recorded footage, putting them in an order and timing them so they tell a story or deliver a message. Editors decide what the audience sees, for how long, and in what sequence.

A finished two-minute video might come from an hour of footage. Most of editing is **choosing what to leave out**.

## Key vocabulary

- **Footage** — the raw recorded video.
- **Clip** — one piece of footage placed in your project.
- **Shot** — a continuous recording from one camera angle.
- **Cut** — the point where one shot ends and the next begins.
- **Sequence** — clips arranged together in order.

## Why cuts work

Our brains accept cuts naturally because we already “cut” our attention many times a minute when we look around. A good cut is often invisible: the viewer follows the story and never notices the edit.

> [!TIP]
> Watch a scene from a favourite film with the sound off and count the cuts. You will notice far more than you expected — and that most of them felt invisible.

uz.body_md:
## Montaj — bu hikoyachilik

**Video montaj** — yozib olingan materialdan eng yaxshi lahzalarni tanlab, ularni hikoya aytadigan yoki xabar yetkazadigan tarzda tartiblash va davomiyligini belgilash. Montajchi tomoshabin nimani, qancha vaqt va qanday ketma-ketlikda koʻrishini hal qiladi.

Tayyor ikki daqiqalik video bir soatlik materialdan yigʻilgan boʻlishi mumkin. Montajning katta qismi — **nimani tashlab yuborishni tanlash**.

## Asosiy atamalar

- **Footage** (xom material) — yozib olingan, ishlov berilmagan video.
- **Klip** — loyihangizga joylashtirilgan bitta material boʻlagi.
- **Lavha** (*shot*, plan) — bitta kamera rakursidan uzluksiz yozib olingan qism.
- **Kesish** (*cut*) — bir lavha tugab, keyingisi boshlanadigan nuqta.
- **Ketma-ketlik** (*sequence*) — tartib bilan joylashtirilgan kliplar toʻplami.

## Kesishlar nega ishlaydi

Miyamiz kesishlarni tabiiy qabul qiladi, chunki atrofga qaraganimizda diqqatimizni daqiqasiga koʻp marta “kesib” turamiz. Yaxshi kesish koʻpincha sezilmaydi: tomoshabin hikoyani kuzatadi va montajni payqamaydi.

> [!TIP]
> Sevimli filmingizdagi bir sahnani ovozsiz tomosha qiling va kesishlarni sanang. Kutganingizdan ancha koʻp kesish borligini — va ularning aksariyati sezilmaganini payqaysiz.

contents.body_md:
## The timeline

Every editor has a **timeline**: time runs left to right, and clips sit on horizontal **tracks**.

- **Video tracks** are stacked: higher tracks appear *on top* of lower ones (useful for titles and overlays).
- **Audio tracks** sit below and play together.

The **playhead** is the vertical line that marks the current frame.

## Project settings

| Setting | Common values | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Resolution** | 1920×1080 (Full HD), 3840×2160 (4K) | Number of pixels in each frame |
| **Frame rate** | 24, 25, 30, 60 fps | Images shown per second |
| **Aspect ratio** | 16:9 (landscape), 9:16 (vertical), 1:1 | Shape of the frame |

> [!NOTE]
> Choose the frame rate before you start and keep it consistent. 24 fps feels cinematic, 25 is common for broadcast in many countries, and 60 is smooth for sports and games.

## Types of cut

- **Hard cut** — a straight switch from one shot to the next. The most common edit.
- **Jump cut** — a cut within the same shot that skips time; popular in vlogs.
- **J-cut** — the *audio* of the next shot starts before its video.
- **L-cut** — the audio of the current shot continues over the next shot’s video.
- **Cutaway** — briefly showing something else (a detail, a reaction) before returning.

## A professional workflow

1. **Organise** — import and name your footage in folders (bins).
2. **Assembly** — place the usable shots roughly in order.
3. **Rough cut** — shape the story; get the structure right.
4. **Fine cut** — perfect the timing of every cut.
5. **Colour and sound** — correct, grade and mix.
6. **Export** — render the final file for its destination.

uz.body_md:
## Vaqt shkalasi

Har bir montaj dasturida **vaqt shkalasi** (*timeline*) bor: vaqt chapdan oʻngga oqadi, kliplar esa gorizontal **treklar**da joylashadi.

- **Video treklar** ustma-ust joylashadi: yuqoridagi treklar pastdagilarning *ustida* koʻrinadi (titrlar va ustki qatlamlar uchun qulay).
- **Audio treklar** pastda joylashadi va birgalikda ijro etiladi.

**Ijro kursori** (*playhead*) — joriy kadrni belgilovchi vertikal chiziq.

## Loyiha sozlamalari

| Sozlama | Keng tarqalgan qiymatlar | Maʼnosi |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Ruxsat** (*resolution*) | 1920×1080 (Full HD), 3840×2160 (4K) | Har bir kadrdagi piksellar soni |
| **Kadrlar chastotasi** (*frame rate*) | 24, 25, 30, 60 fps | Bir soniyada koʻrsatiladigan tasvirlar soni |
| **Tomonlar nisbati** (*aspect ratio*) | 16:9 (gorizontal), 9:16 (vertikal), 1:1 | Kadrning shakli |

> [!NOTE]
> Kadrlar chastotasini ishni boshlashdan oldin tanlang va butun loyiha davomida oʻzgartirmang. 24 fps kinematografik taassurot beradi, 25 fps koʻplab mamlakatlarda televideniye uchun odatiy, 60 fps esa sport va oʻyinlar uchun silliq harakat beradi.

## Kesish turlari

- **Toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri kesish** (*hard cut*) — bir lavhadan keyingisiga toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri oʻtish. Eng koʻp ishlatiladigan montaj usuli.
- **Jump cut** (sakrash) — bitta lavha ichida vaqtni tashlab oʻtuvchi kesish; vloglarda mashhur.
- **J-cut** — keyingi lavhaning *ovozi* uning tasviridan oldin boshlanadi.
- **L-cut** — joriy lavhaning ovozi keyingi lavha tasviri ustida davom etadi.
- **Cutaway** (chetga burilish) — asosiy lavhaga qaytishdan oldin qisqa vaqt boshqa narsani (detal, reaksiya) koʻrsatish.

## Professional ish jarayoni

1. **Tartiblash** — materialni import qiling va papkalarga (*bins*) nomlab joylang.
2. **Yigʻish** (*assembly*) — yaroqli lavhalarni taxminiy tartibda joylashtiring.
3. **Qoralama montaj** (*rough cut*) — hikoyani shakllantiring, tuzilmani toʻgʻri yoʻlga qoʻying.
4. **Yakuniy montaj** (*fine cut*) — har bir kesishning vaqtini mukammallashtiring.
5. **Rang va ovoz** — rang korreksiyasi, rang tusini berish va ovozni aralashtirish.
6. **Eksport** — yakuniy faylni u moʻljallangan joy uchun render qiling.

contents.body_md:
## Not starting from nothing

Every game needs to draw images, play sounds, read the controller, simulate physics and load levels. Writing all of that from scratch would take years. A **game engine** is a ready-made foundation that provides these systems so creators can focus on *their* game.

## What an engine typically provides

- **Rendering** — drawing 3D worlds in real time, many times per second.
- **Physics** — gravity, collisions and objects that fall and bounce.
- **Input** — keyboard, mouse, gamepad and touch.
- **Audio** — positional sound and music.
- **Scripting** — ways to describe game rules and behaviour.
- **Tools** — an editor to build levels and manage assets.

## Unreal Engine in particular

Unreal Engine is developed by Epic Games. Version 5 introduced systems such as **Nanite** (very detailed geometry) and **Lumen** (dynamic global illumination). Behaviour can be built with **Blueprints**, a visual node-based system, or written in **C++**.

> [!NOTE]
> Unreal Engine is free to download and learn. Commercial releases are subject to Epic’s licence terms — always read the current EULA on unrealengine.com before publishing a product.

uz.body_md:
## Noldan boshlamaslik

Har bir oʻyin tasvirlarni chizishi, tovushlarni ijro etishi, boshqaruv qurilmasini oʻqishi, fizikani simulyatsiya qilishi va darajalarni yuklashi kerak. Bularning barchasini noldan yozish yillar talab qiladi. **Oʻyin dvigateli** (*game engine*) — shu tizimlarni taqdim etadigan tayyor poydevor; u yaratuvchilarga *oʻz* oʻyiniga eʼtibor qaratish imkonini beradi.

## Dvigatel odatda nimalarni taqdim etadi

- **Rendering** — 3D olamlarni real vaqtda, soniyasiga koʻp marta chizish.
- **Fizika** — tortishish kuchi, toʻqnashuvlar, yiqiladigan va sakraydigan obyektlar.
- **Kiritish** — klaviatura, sichqoncha, geympad va sensorli ekran.
- **Audio** — fazoviy tovush va musiqa.
- **Skriptlash** — oʻyin qoidalari va xatti-harakatlarini tavsiflash usullari.
- **Vositalar** — darajalar qurish va resurslarni boshqarish uchun muharrir.

## Aynan Unreal Engine haqida

Unreal Engine’ni Epic Games kompaniyasi ishlab chiqadi. 5-versiyada **Nanite** (juda batafsil geometriya) va **Lumen** (dinamik global yoritish) kabi tizimlar paydo boʻldi. Xatti-harakatlarni tugunlarga asoslangan vizual tizim — **Blueprints** yordamida qurish yoki **C++** tilida yozish mumkin.

> [!NOTE]
> Unreal Engine’ni yuklab olish va oʻrganish bepul. Tijoriy mahsulotlar esa Epic litsenziya shartlariga boʻysunadi — mahsulot chiqarishdan oldin har doim unrealengine.com saytidagi amaldagi EULA (litsenziya kelishuvi)ni oʻqing.

contents.body_md:
## Contrast

**Contrast** is difference: large vs small, dark vs light, bold vs thin. Contrast creates interest and tells people which things are different. Make differences **obvious** — two font sizes that are almost the same look like a mistake.

> [!WARNING]
> Text must contrast strongly with its background to be readable. Accessibility guidelines (WCAG) recommend a contrast ratio of at least **4.5 : 1** for normal body text.

## Alignment

**Alignment** means placing elements along shared invisible lines. Aligned elements look connected and organised; randomly placed elements look careless. Pick one alignment (for example, everything left-aligned to the same edge) and stick to it.

## Proximity

**Proximity** means related items belong close together, and unrelated items are separated by space. A caption sits right under its photo; a new section starts after a larger gap.

## Repetition and white space

- **Repetition** — reuse the same colours, fonts and spacing so the design feels like one system.
- **White space** — empty space is not wasted space. It gives content room to breathe and makes everything easier to read.

uz.body_md:
## Kontrast

**Kontrast** — bu farq: katta va kichik, toʻq va och, qalin va ingichka. Kontrast qiziqish uygʻotadi va qaysi narsalar bir-biridan farq qilishini koʻrsatadi. Farqlarni **yaqqol** qiling — deyarli bir xil boʻlgan ikki shrift oʻlchami xatodek koʻrinadi.

> [!WARNING]
> Matn oʻqilishi uchun u fon bilan kuchli kontrast hosil qilishi kerak. Foydalanish qulayligi boʻyicha tavsiyalar (WCAG) oddiy asosiy matn uchun kamida **4.5 : 1** kontrast nisbatini tavsiya etadi.

## Tekislash

**Tekislash** (*alignment*) — elementlarni umumiy koʻrinmas chiziqlar boʻylab joylashtirish. Tekislangan elementlar bir-biriga bogʻliq va tartibli koʻrinadi; tartibsiz joylashganlari esa eʼtiborsizlikdek taassurot qoldiradi. Bitta tekislash usulini tanlang (masalan, hamma narsani bir xil chap chetga tekislang) va unga amal qiling.

## Yaqinlik

**Yaqinlik** (*proximity*) — bir-biriga aloqador elementlar yonma-yon, aloqasizlari esa boʻsh joy bilan ajratilgan boʻlishi kerak. Rasm izohi rasmning ostida turadi; yangi boʻlim esa kattaroq boʻsh joydan keyin boshlanadi.

## Takrorlash va boʻsh joy

- **Takrorlash** — dizayn yagona tizimdek tuyulishi uchun bir xil ranglar, shriftlar va oraliqlardan qayta foydalaning.
- **Boʻsh joy** — boʻsh joy behuda sarflangan joy emas. U kontentga “nafas olish” imkonini beradi va hamma narsani oʻqishni osonlashtiradi.

contents.body_md:
## Before you install: is your computer ready?

Unreal Engine is professional software that renders detailed 3D worlds in real time, so it asks a lot of your computer. Requirements change between engine versions, so always open the official **Hardware and Software Specifications** page in the Unreal Engine documentation for the exact version you are installing. The table below is practical guidance for learning, not an official specification.

| Part | Workable for learning | Comfortable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Operating system | 64-bit Windows 10/11 or a recent macOS | The same, fully updated |
| Processor (CPU) | Recent quad-core | 6–8 cores or more |
| Memory (RAM) | 16 GB | 32 GB or more |
| Graphics (GPU) | Dedicated graphics card with current drivers | More video memory (8 GB or more) |
| Storage | SSD with plenty of free space | Fast NVMe SSD |

> [!NOTE]
> The engine installation alone typically takes several tens of gigabytes, and projects grow as you add content. Install on an SSD rather than a hard drive: the editor opens and compiles far faster.

Laptops with only integrated graphics can usually open the editor, but advanced lighting features may be slow. You will learn to lower the quality settings at the end of this lesson. Linux is supported through separate downloads; this course shows Windows and macOS.

## Step 1: Create an Epic Games account

Unreal Engine is distributed by Epic Games. Create a free account at **epicgames.com** and turn on two-factor authentication for security.

## Step 2: Install the Epic Games Launcher

Download the **Epic Games Launcher** from the official Epic Games or Unreal Engine website, install it and sign in.

> [!WARNING]
> Download only from official Epic Games websites. Unofficial “free Unreal Engine” downloads are a common way to spread malware — the real engine is free from Epic.

## Step 3: Install an engine version

1. In the Launcher, open **Unreal Engine** in the left sidebar, then the **Library** tab.
2. Next to **Engine Versions**, click the **+** button and choose the latest 5.x release (this course states the version it was recorded with).
3. Click **Install**, then choose a folder on your SSD.
4. Open **Options** before confirming. **Starter Content** and **Templates and Feature Packs** are useful for learning. **Editor symbols for debugging** are large and only needed for C++ debugging, and extra **Target Platforms** (such as Android or iOS) can be added later.

The download is large. You can keep using your computer while it installs.

## Step 4: The first launch

Click **Launch**. The first start can take a long time because Unreal prepares its **shaders** — small programs that tell the graphics card how to draw materials. You may see a percentage counter. This is normal and happens mostly the first time you open a version or a project.

## Step 5: Create your first project

The **Unreal Project Browser** opens.

1. Choose the **Games** category, then the **Third Person** template. It gives you a playable character, so you can test things immediately.
2. Under the project defaults, choose **Blueprint** (you will learn C++ later), target **Desktop**, and quality preset **Maximum** — or **Scalable** on a modest computer.
3. Keep **Starter Content** enabled. It adds free props and materials to practise with.
4. Pick a location and a short name without spaces, such as `MyFirstProject`, and click **Create**.

When the editor opens, press **Alt + P** (or the **Play** button) to walk around with the character. Press **Esc** to stop playing.

## Licence awareness

Unreal Engine is free to download and learn. If you release a commercial product, Epic's licence terms apply, including possible royalties above certain revenue thresholds. These terms change, so read the current **EULA** on Epic's website before you publish anything.

## Common problems

| Problem | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| The download is stuck or very slow | Pause and resume it in the Launcher, and check that the drive has enough free space |
| The editor crashes on start | Update your graphics drivers from NVIDIA, AMD or Intel, then restart the computer |
| The editor is very slow | Open **Settings → Engine Scalability Settings** in the viewport toolbar and choose **Medium** or **Low** |
| “Not enough disk space” | Install the engine or the project on a drive with more free space |

## Try it

Install the engine, create `MyFirstProject` from the Third Person template, press **Play**, run around the level and then stop with **Esc**.

## Key terms

- **Epic Games Launcher** — the app that installs and updates Unreal Engine.
- **Engine version** — a numbered release such as 5.x; projects open in the version they were made with.
- **Template** — a ready-made starting project (Blank, First Person, Third Person and others).
- **Shaders** — programs the graphics card uses to draw surfaces; Unreal compiles them the first time.

uz.body_md:
## Oʻrnatishdan oldin: kompyuteringiz tayyormi?

Unreal Engine — batafsil 3D olamlarni real vaqtda chizadigan professional dastur, shuning uchun u kompyuterdan koʻp narsa talab qiladi. Talablar dvigatel versiyasiga qarab oʻzgaradi, shu bois oʻrnatayotgan versiyangiz uchun Unreal Engine hujjatlaridagi rasmiy **Hardware and Software Specifications** (apparat va dasturiy taʼminot talablari) sahifasini albatta oching. Quyidagi jadval rasmiy talab emas, balki oʻqish uchun amaliy tavsiya.

| Qism | Oʻqish uchun yetarli | Qulay ishlash uchun |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Operatsion tizim | 64 bitli Windows 10/11 yoki yangi macOS | Xuddi shunday, toʻliq yangilangan |
| Protsessor (CPU) | Yangi avlod toʻrt yadroli | 6–8 va undan ortiq yadro |
| Operativ xotira (RAM) | 16 GB | 32 GB va undan koʻp |
| Grafika (GPU) | Drayverlari yangilangan alohida videokarta | Koʻproq video xotira (8 GB va undan ortiq) |
| Doimiy xotira | Boʻsh joyi yetarli SSD | Tezkor NVMe SSD |

> [!NOTE]
> Dvigatelning oʻzi odatda bir necha oʻn gigabayt joy egallaydi, loyihalar esa kontent qoʻshilgani sari kattalashadi. Dvigatelni qattiq diskka emas, SSD ga oʻrnating: muharrir ancha tez ochiladi va kompilyatsiya qiladi.

Faqat integratsiyalashgan grafikaga ega noutbuklar odatda muharrirni ocha oladi, biroq murakkab yoritish imkoniyatlari sekin ishlashi mumkin. Dars oxirida sifat sozlamalarini qanday pasaytirishni oʻrganasiz. Linux alohida yuklab olinadigan versiyalar orqali qoʻllab-quvvatlanadi; bu kursda Windows va macOS koʻrsatiladi.

## 1-qadam: Epic Games hisobini yarating

Unreal Engine’ni Epic Games kompaniyasi tarqatadi. **epicgames.com** saytida bepul hisob yarating va xavfsizlik uchun ikki bosqichli autentifikatsiyani yoqing.

## 2-qadam: Epic Games Launcher dasturini oʻrnating

**Epic Games Launcher** dasturini Epic Games yoki Unreal Engine’ning rasmiy saytidan yuklab oling, oʻrnating va hisobingizga kiring.

> [!WARNING]
> Faqat Epic Games’ning rasmiy saytlaridan yuklab oling. Norasmiy “bepul Unreal Engine” yuklamalari zararli dasturlarni tarqatishning keng tarqalgan usuli — haqiqiy dvigatel Epic’da bepul.

## 3-qadam: Dvigatel versiyasini oʻrnating

1. Launcher’da chap paneldagi **Unreal Engine** boʻlimini, soʻngra **Library** yorligʻini oching.
2. **Engine Versions** yonidagi **+** tugmasini bosing va eng soʻnggi 5.x versiyani tanlang (kursda qaysi versiyada yozilgani koʻrsatiladi).
3. **Install** tugmasini bosing va SSD dagi papkani tanlang.
4. Tasdiqlashdan oldin **Options** ni oching. Oʻqish uchun **Starter Content** va **Templates and Feature Packs** foydali. **Editor symbols for debugging** katta hajmli va faqat C++ kodini tuzatish uchun kerak, qoʻshimcha **Target Platforms** (masalan, Android yoki iOS) esa keyinroq qoʻshilishi mumkin.

Yuklama katta hajmli. Oʻrnatilayotgan paytda kompyuterdan foydalanishda davom etishingiz mumkin.

## 4-qadam: Birinchi ishga tushirish

**Launch** tugmasini bosing. Birinchi ishga tushirish uzoq davom etishi mumkin, chunki Unreal **sheyderlar**ni (*shaders*) tayyorlaydi — bu videokartaga materiallarni qanday chizishni aytadigan kichik dasturlar. Foiz hisoblagichini koʻrishingiz mumkin. Bu odatiy hol va asosan versiya yoki loyiha birinchi marta ochilganda sodir boʻladi.

## 5-qadam: Birinchi loyihangizni yarating

**Unreal Project Browser** (loyihalar oynasi) ochiladi.

1. **Games** toifasini, soʻngra **Third Person** shablonini tanlang. U boshqariladigan personaj beradi, shuning uchun narsalarni darhol sinab koʻrishingiz mumkin.
2. Loyiha sozlamalarida **Blueprint** ni (C++ ni keyinroq oʻrganasiz), maqsadli platforma sifatida **Desktop** ni va sifat darajasi sifatida **Maximum** ni — oddiyroq kompyuterda esa **Scalable** ni tanlang.
3. **Starter Content** yoqilgan holda qolsin. U mashq qilish uchun bepul buyumlar va materiallar qoʻshadi.
4. Joylashuvni va boʻsh joysiz qisqa nomni, masalan, `MyFirstProject` ni tanlab, **Create** tugmasini bosing.

Muharrir ochilgach, personaj bilan yurib koʻrish uchun **Alt + P** ni (yoki **Play** tugmasini) bosing. Oʻyinni toʻxtatish uchun **Esc** ni bosing.

## Litsenziya haqida

Unreal Engine’ni yuklab olish va oʻrganish bepul. Agar tijoriy mahsulot chiqarsangiz, Epic litsenziya shartlari amal qiladi, jumladan, maʼlum daromad chegarasidan yuqorida royalti toʻlash talab qilinishi mumkin. Bu shartlar oʻzgarib turadi, shuning uchun biror narsani eʼlon qilishdan oldin Epic saytidagi amaldagi **EULA** (litsenziya kelishuvi) ni oʻqing.

## Keng tarqalgan muammolar

| Muammo | Nima qilish kerak |
| --- | --- |
| Yuklab olish toʻxtab qolgan yoki juda sekin | Launcher’da yuklamani pauza qilib, qayta davom ettiring va diskda boʻsh joy yetarliligini tekshiring |
| Muharrir ishga tushganda yopilib qoladi | Videokarta drayverlarini NVIDIA, AMD yoki Intel saytidan yangilang va kompyuterni qayta ishga tushiring |
| Muharrir juda sekin ishlaydi | Koʻrinish maydoni panelidagi **Settings → Engine Scalability Settings** ni oching va **Medium** yoki **Low** ni tanlang |
| “Diskda joy yetarli emas” | Dvigatel yoki loyihani boʻsh joyi koʻproq diskka oʻrnating |

## Oʻzingiz sinab koʻring

Dvigatelni oʻrnating, Third Person shablonidan `MyFirstProject` loyihasini yarating, **Play** ni bosing, daraja boʻylab yuguring va **Esc** bilan toʻxtating.

## Asosiy atamalar

- **Epic Games Launcher** — Unreal Engine’ni oʻrnatadigan va yangilaydigan dastur.
- **Dvigatel versiyasi** — 5.x kabi raqamlangan reliz; loyihalar ular yaratilgan versiyada ochiladi.
- **Shablon** (*template*) — tayyor boshlangʻich loyiha (Blank, First Person, Third Person va boshqalar).
- **Sheyderlar** (*shaders*) — videokarta sirtlarni chizish uchun foydalanadigan dasturlar; Unreal ularni birinchi marta kompilyatsiya qiladi.

contents.body_md:
## The main areas of the editor

When your project opens, you see the **Level Editor**. Its default layout has six areas worth knowing by name:

1. **Main toolbar** (top) — saving, the editing mode selector, the **Quickly add to the project** button for placing actors, and the **Play** controls.
2. **Level Viewport** (centre) — your window into the level. Here you look around, select objects and move them.
3. **Outliner** (top right) — a list of every **actor** (object) in the level, like a table of contents.
4. **Details panel** (right, below the Outliner) — the properties of whatever is selected: its position, rotation and scale (the **Transform**), its components and its settings.
5. **Content Drawer** (bottom, or press **Ctrl + Space**) — all the **assets** in your project: meshes, materials, textures, sounds and Blueprints, organised in folders.
6. **Bottom toolbar** — the Output Log and a console for advanced commands.

> [!TIP]
> Every panel can be closed, moved and docked. If you lose one, open it again from the **Window** menu. **Window → Load Layout → Default Editor Layout** restores the original arrangement.

## Moving around the viewport

| Action | How |
| --- | --- |
| Fly through the level | Hold the **right mouse button** and use **W A S D** (Q and E move down and up) |
| Change flying speed | While holding the right mouse button, scroll the mouse wheel |
| Focus on the selected actor | Press **F** |
| Orbit around the focus point | **Alt + left mouse button** drag |
| Zoom | Scroll the mouse wheel |

If you know Blender, notice the difference: Blender orbits with the middle mouse button, while Unreal is built around flying like a game camera.

## Selecting and transforming actors

- **Click** an actor to select it; **Ctrl + click** adds or removes actors from the selection.
- **W** switches to Move, **E** to Rotate and **R** to Scale. Drag the coloured handles of the **gizmo**: red is X, green is Y and blue is Z. In Unreal, **Z points up**.
- **End** drops the selected actor onto the surface below it.
- **Ctrl + D** duplicates the selection, and **Delete** removes it.
- In the viewport toolbar you can switch between **world** and **local** axes and turn **grid snapping** on or off for movement, rotation and scale.

## Placing actors

There are two everyday ways to add something to the level:

- Click **Quickly add to the project** in the main toolbar and choose, for example, **Shapes → Cube**.
- Drag an asset from the **Content Drawer** into the viewport. Starter Content has chairs, tables, lamps and materials in its folders.

## Play and Simulate

- **Play** (**Alt + P**) starts the game in the viewport with you controlling the player. Press **Esc** to stop.
- **Simulate** (**Alt + S**) runs physics and logic while you keep the editor camera, which is useful for watching things happen.

> [!WARNING]
> Changes you make to the level **while playing** are thrown away when you stop. Always stop playing before you edit.

## Saving your work

- **Ctrl + S** saves the current level. **Ctrl + Shift + S** (**Save All**) saves every changed asset.
- Levels are saved as `.umap` files and other assets as `.uasset` files inside the project's `Content` folder.

> [!WARNING]
> Never move or rename asset files in Windows Explorer or Finder. Unreal keeps references between assets; moving files outside the editor breaks them. Always rename and move assets inside the Content Drawer.

## Keeping a project tidy

Professional teams name assets with short prefixes so they can find them quickly:

| Prefix | Asset type |
| --- | --- |
| `SM_` | Static mesh |
| `M_` | Material |
| `MI_` | Material instance |
| `T_` | Texture |
| `BP_` | Blueprint |

Create your own folder (for example `Content/MyFirstProject`) so your work never mixes with Starter Content.

## Try it: a ten-step tour

1. Open the Content Drawer with **Ctrl + Space**.
2. Find a chair in the Starter Content `Props` folder.
3. Drag it into the level.
4. Press **F** to focus on it.
5. Move it with **W** along the X axis only.
6. Rotate it 90° with **E** and grid snapping on.
7. Duplicate it with **Ctrl + D** and place the copy next to the table.
8. Find both chairs in the Outliner and rename one of them.
9. Press **Alt + P**, walk to the chairs, then stop with **Esc**.
10. Save everything with **Ctrl + Shift + S**.

## Common mistakes

- Editing while the game is playing — the changes disappear when you stop.
- Losing the view — select something and press **F**, or use the **Perspective** menu to reset the view.
- Moving files outside the editor — broken references and missing assets.

## Key terms

- **Actor** — anything placed in a level: a mesh, a light, a camera, a character.
- **Asset** — a file in the Content Drawer that actors can use, such as a mesh or a material.
- **Transform** — an actor's location, rotation and scale.
- **Level** — a map that contains actors; saved as a `.umap` file.

uz.body_md:
## Muharrirning asosiy qismlari

Loyihangiz ochilganda **Level Editor** (daraja muharriri) ni koʻrasiz. Uning standart joylashuvida nomini bilib olish kerak boʻlgan oltita qism bor:

1. **Asosiy asboblar paneli** (yuqorida) — saqlash, tahrirlash rejimini tanlash, obyekt joylashtirish uchun **Quickly add to the project** tugmasi va **Play** boshqaruvlari.
2. **Level Viewport** (koʻrinish maydoni, markazda) — darajaga ochilgan oynangiz. Bu yerda atrofni koʻzdan kechirasiz, obyektlarni tanlaysiz va siljitasiz.
3. **Outliner** (oʻng yuqorida) — darajadagi barcha **aktorlar** (obyektlar) roʻyxati, xuddi mundarija kabi.
4. **Details paneli** (oʻngda, Outliner ostida) — tanlangan narsaning xususiyatlari: joylashuvi, burilishi va masshtabi (**Transform**), komponentlari va sozlamalari.
5. **Content Drawer** (pastda yoki **Ctrl + Space**) — loyihangizdagi barcha **resurslar** (*assets*): meshlar, materiallar, teksturalar, tovushlar va Blueprint’lar papkalarga ajratilgan holda.
6. **Pastki asboblar paneli** — Output Log (jurnal) va murakkab buyruqlar uchun konsol.

> [!TIP]
> Har bir panelni yopish, koʻchirish va biriktirish mumkin. Biror panelni yoʻqotib qoʻysangiz, uni **Window** menyusidan qayta oching. **Window → Load Layout → Default Editor Layout** dastlabki joylashuvni tiklaydi.

## Koʻrinish maydonida harakatlanish

| Harakat | Qanday qilinadi |
| --- | --- |
| Daraja boʻylab uchish | **Sichqonchaning oʻng tugmasini** bosib turib, **W A S D** dan foydalaning (Q va E pastga va yuqoriga siljitadi) |
| Uchish tezligini oʻzgartirish | Oʻng tugmani bosib turgan holda sichqoncha gʻildiragini aylantiring |
| Tanlangan aktorga eʼtibor qaratish | **F** ni bosing |
| Diqqat nuqtasi atrofida aylanish | **Alt + sichqonchaning chap tugmasi** bilan torting |
| Yaqinlashtirish | Sichqoncha gʻildiragini aylantiring |

Agar Blenderni bilsangiz, farqqa eʼtibor bering: Blender oʻrta tugma bilan aylantiradi, Unreal esa oʻyin kamerasi kabi uchishga asoslangan.

## Aktorlarni tanlash va transformatsiya qilish

- Aktorni tanlash uchun uni **bosing**; **Ctrl + bosish** tanlovga aktor qoʻshadi yoki undan olib tashlaydi.
- **W** siljitishga, **E** aylantirishga, **R** masshtablashga oʻtkazadi. **Gizmo**ning rangli dastaklarini torting: qizil — X, yashil — Y, koʻk — Z. Unreal’da **Z oʻqi yuqoriga qaragan**.
- **End** tanlangan aktorni ostidagi sirtga tushiradi.
- **Ctrl + D** tanlovni nusxalaydi, **Delete** esa oʻchiradi.
- Koʻrinish maydoni panelida **global** (*world*) va **lokal** (*local*) oʻqlar orasida almashish hamda siljitish, aylantirish va masshtablash uchun **toʻrga yopishish**ni (*grid snapping*) yoqish yoki oʻchirish mumkin.

## Aktorlarni joylashtirish

Darajaga biror narsa qoʻshishning ikkita kundalik usuli bor:

- Asosiy asboblar panelidagi **Quickly add to the project** tugmasini bosing va, masalan, **Shapes → Cube** ni tanlang.
- **Content Drawer** dan resursni koʻrinish maydoniga torting. Starter Content papkalarida stullar, stollar, chiroqlar va materiallar bor.

## Play va Simulate

- **Play** (**Alt + P**) oʻyinni koʻrinish maydonida ishga tushiradi va oʻyinchini siz boshqarasiz. Toʻxtatish uchun **Esc** ni bosing.
- **Simulate** (**Alt + S**) muharrir kamerasi sizda qolgan holda fizika va mantiqni ishga tushiradi — jarayonlarni kuzatish uchun qulay.

> [!WARNING]
> Oʻyin **ishlab turgan paytda** darajaga kiritgan oʻzgarishlaringiz toʻxtatganingizda bekor boʻladi. Tahrirlashdan oldin har doim oʻyinni toʻxtating.

## Ishingizni saqlash

- **Ctrl + S** joriy darajani saqlaydi. **Ctrl + Shift + S** (**Save All**) oʻzgargan barcha resurslarni saqlaydi.
- Darajalar `.umap` fayllari, boshqa resurslar esa loyihaning `Content` papkasida `.uasset` fayllari sifatida saqlanadi.

> [!WARNING]
> Resurs fayllarini hech qachon Windows Explorer yoki Finder orqali koʻchirmang va qayta nomlamang. Unreal resurslar orasidagi bogʻlanishlarni saqlaydi; fayllarni muharrirdan tashqarida koʻchirish bu bogʻlanishlarni buzadi. Resurslarni har doim Content Drawer ichida qayta nomlang va koʻchiring.

## Loyihani tartibli saqlash

Professional jamoalar resurslarni tez topish uchun ularga qisqa prefiksli nomlar beradi:

| Prefiks | Resurs turi |
| --- | --- |
| `SM_` | Statik mesh |
| `M_` | Material |
| `MI_` | Material nusxasi (*material instance*) |
| `T_` | Tekstura |
| `BP_` | Blueprint |

Ishingiz Starter Content bilan aralashib ketmasligi uchun oʻz papkangizni yarating (masalan, `Content/MyFirstProject`).

## Oʻzingiz sinab koʻring: oʻn qadamli sayohat

1. **Ctrl + Space** bilan Content Drawer ni oching.
2. Starter Content’ning `Props` papkasidan stul toping.
3. Uni darajaga torting.
4. Unga eʼtibor qaratish uchun **F** ni bosing.
5. Uni **W** yordamida faqat X oʻqi boʻylab siljiting.
6. Toʻrga yopishish yoqilgan holda **E** bilan 90° ga aylantiring.
7. **Ctrl + D** bilan nusxalang va nusxani stol yoniga qoʻying.
8. Ikkala stulni Outliner’dan toping va ulardan birini qayta nomlang.
9. **Alt + P** ni bosing, stullar yoniga boring va **Esc** bilan toʻxtating.
10. Hammasini **Ctrl + Shift + S** bilan saqlang.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar

- Oʻyin ishlab turganda tahrirlash — toʻxtatganingizda oʻzgarishlar yoʻqoladi.
- Koʻrinishni yoʻqotib qoʻyish — biror narsani tanlab **F** ni bosing yoki koʻrinishni tiklash uchun **Perspective** menyusidan foydalaning.
- Fayllarni muharrirdan tashqarida koʻchirish — bogʻlanishlar buziladi va resurslar yoʻqoladi.

## Asosiy atamalar

- **Aktor** (*actor*) — darajaga joylashtirilgan har qanday narsa: mesh, yorugʻlik manbai, kamera, personaj.
- **Resurs** (*asset*) — Content Drawer dagi, aktorlar foydalanishi mumkin boʻlgan fayl, masalan, mesh yoki material.
- **Transform** — aktorning joylashuvi, burilishi va masshtabi.
- **Daraja** (*level*) — aktorlarni oʻz ichiga olgan xarita; `.umap` fayli sifatida saqlanadi.

## Your first Unreal project

Use what you learned in this module to build a small room or outdoor corner from **Starter Content** props. The goal is not beautiful art yet — it is confident, tidy use of the editor.

### Requirements

1. A project created from a template that opens without errors.
2. At least **10 props** from Starter Content placed in the level.
3. Use all three transform tools (**W**, **E**, **R**) and grid snapping; props rest on surfaces (use **End**).
4. Every placed actor has a meaningful name in the Outliner (for example `Chair_Kitchen_01`).
5. Your own folder in the Content Drawer for anything you create or duplicate.
6. The level and all assets are saved.

### How to submit

Upload **three screenshots** — two from different viewpoints in the editor and one from **Play** mode — and write two or three sentences about what you built and which tools you used. You can also paste a link to a short screen recording.

> [!NOTE]
> A reviewer checks your work against the rubric and leaves feedback. You can improve your scene and resubmit.

## Birinchi Unreal loyihangiz

Ushbu modulda oʻrganganlaringizdan foydalanib, **Starter Content** buyumlaridan kichik xona yoki ochiq maydon burchagini yarating. Hozircha maqsad chiroyli sanʼat asari emas — muharrirdan ishonch bilan va tartibli foydalanish.

### Talablar

1. Shablondan yaratilgan va xatosiz ochiladigan loyiha.
2. Darajaga joylashtirilgan kamida **10 ta** Starter Content buyumi.
3. Uchala transformatsiya vositasidan (**W**, **E**, **R**) va toʻrga yopishishdan foydalanilgan; buyumlar sirtlarda turibdi (**End** dan foydalaning).
4. Joylashtirilgan har bir aktorning Outliner’da mazmunli nomi bor (masalan, `Chair_Kitchen_01`).
5. Siz yaratgan yoki nusxalagan narsalar uchun Content Drawer’da oʻz papkangiz.
6. Daraja va barcha resurslar saqlangan.

### Qanday topshiriladi

**Uchta skrinshot** yuklang — ikkitasi muharrirdagi turli nuqtalardan, bittasi **Play** rejimidan — va nima yaratganingiz hamda qaysi vositalardan foydalanganingiz haqida ikki-uch gap yozing. Qisqa ekran yozuviga havola ham joylashingiz mumkin.

> [!NOTE]
> Tekshiruvchi ishingizni baholash mezonlari asosida koʻrib chiqadi va fikr-mulohaza qoldiradi. Sahnangizni yaxshilab, qayta topshirishingiz mumkin.

contents.body_md:
## Three parts that work together

In this lesson you will learn what the processor, memory and storage actually do, so you can understand any computer's specifications. Every time you open an app, these three parts work as a team:

1. The app's files are read from **storage**.
2. They are loaded into **memory (RAM)**, where they can be reached quickly.
3. The **processor (CPU)** follows the app's instructions, step by step.

## The processor (CPU)

The CPU repeats one simple cycle billions of times per second: **fetch** an instruction, **work out** what it means, **carry it out**.

- **Clock speed**, measured in gigahertz (GHz), is how many cycles happen each second. 3 GHz means about three billion cycles per second.
- **Cores** are independent workers inside one processor. A 6-core CPU can work on six streams of instructions at the same time.

More cores help when a job can be split into parts — exporting video, rendering 3D, compiling code or running many apps at once. Many everyday tasks run mainly on one core, so a CPU with fewer but faster cores can feel just as quick for web browsing and documents.

> [!NOTE]
> The **GPU** (graphics processor) has hundreds or thousands of small cores designed for doing the same calculation on many pixels at once. That is why it is so good at graphics, video and AI work.

## Memory (RAM)

RAM is the computer's **workspace**. Everything you have open right now — browser tabs, documents, the operating system itself — lives in RAM. It is very fast, but it is cleared when the power goes off.

When RAM is full, the operating system moves some data to storage to make room (a *page file* or *swap*). Storage is much slower than RAM, so the computer suddenly feels sluggish.

| Kind of use | Workable RAM | Comfortable RAM |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Web, documents, studying | 8 GB | 16 GB |
| Programming, design | 16 GB | 32 GB |
| Video editing, 3D, games | 16 GB | 32 GB or more |

## Storage

Storage keeps your files and apps when the computer is off. There are three common kinds:

- **HDD** (hard disk drive) — spinning magnetic disks. Cheap for large capacity, but slow and sensitive to knocks.
- **SATA SSD** — no moving parts and several times faster than an HDD.
- **NVMe SSD** — connects directly to the motherboard (usually in an *M.2* slot) and is the fastest common option.

An SSD makes the whole computer feel faster: it starts up in seconds and apps open quickly. For most people, an SSD matters more than a slightly faster processor.

## A worked example

You open a 50 MB photo in an editor. The photo is read from the **SSD**, loaded into **RAM**, the **CPU** runs the editor's instructions, the **GPU** helps apply a filter, and the result appears on the screen. If RAM is almost full, the computer has to keep swapping data to storage, and every click feels slow.

## Try it

Find the processor, RAM and storage of the computer you are using:

- **Windows:** **Settings → System → About**, and **Task Manager → Performance** (press **Ctrl + Shift + Esc**).
- **macOS:** **Apple menu → About This Mac**.

Write down the number of cores, the amount of RAM and the type and size of storage.

## Common mistakes

- Judging a processor by GHz alone. Cores and the processor's generation matter as much.
- Buying a lot of storage but too little RAM, so the computer slows down whenever several apps are open.
- Mixing up RAM and storage. When a phone is advertised with “128 GB”, that is storage, not RAM.

## Key terms

- **CPU / core** — the processor and one of its independent workers.
- **Clock speed (GHz)** — cycles per second, in billions.
- **RAM** — fast, temporary working memory.
- **SSD / HDD / NVMe** — kinds of permanent storage, from fastest (NVMe) to slowest (HDD).

uz.body_md:
## Birgalikda ishlaydigan uchta qism

Bu darsda protsessor, operativ xotira va doimiy xotira aslida nima qilishini bilib olasiz — shunda istalgan kompyuterning texnik tavsifini tushuna olasiz. Har safar ilovani ochganingizda bu uch qism jamoa boʻlib ishlaydi:

1. Ilova fayllari **doimiy xotira**dan oʻqiladi.
2. Ular tez murojaat qilish mumkin boʻlgan **operativ xotira (RAM)** ga yuklanadi.
3. **Protsessor (CPU)** ilovaning koʻrsatmalarini qadamma-qadam bajaradi.

## Protsessor (CPU)

Protsessor har soniyada milliardlab marta bitta oddiy siklni takrorlaydi: koʻrsatmani **oladi**, uning maʼnosini **aniqlaydi** va uni **bajaradi**.

- **Takt chastotasi** gigagerts (GHz) bilan oʻlchanadi va har soniyada nechta sikl bajarilishini bildiradi. 3 GHz — soniyasiga taxminan uch milliard sikl degani.
- **Yadrolar** — bitta protsessor ichidagi mustaqil “ishchilar”. 6 yadroli protsessor bir vaqtning oʻzida oltita koʻrsatmalar oqimi ustida ishlay oladi.

Koʻp yadro ishni qismlarga boʻlish mumkin boʻlganda yordam beradi: videoni eksport qilish, 3D render qilish, kodni kompilyatsiya qilish yoki bir vaqtda koʻp ilova bilan ishlash. Koʻplab kundalik vazifalar asosan bitta yadroda bajariladi, shuning uchun yadrolari kamroq, lekin tezroq protsessor internetda ishlash va hujjatlar uchun xuddi shunday tez tuyulishi mumkin.

> [!NOTE]
> **GPU** (grafik protsessor) bir xil hisob-kitobni koʻplab piksellar uchun bir vaqtda bajarishga moʻljallangan yuzlab yoki minglab kichik yadrolarga ega. Shu sababli u grafika, video va sunʼiy intellekt bilan ishlashda juda kuchli.

## Operativ xotira (RAM)

RAM — kompyuterning **ish stoli**. Hozir ochiq turgan hamma narsa — brauzer yorliqlari, hujjatlar, hatto operatsion tizimning oʻzi — RAMda joylashadi. U juda tez, ammo elektr oʻchganda tozalanadi.

RAM toʻlib qolganda operatsion tizim joy boʻshatish uchun maʼlumotlarning bir qismini doimiy xotiraga koʻchiradi (*page file* yoki *swap*). Doimiy xotira RAMdan ancha sekin, shuning uchun kompyuter birdan sekinlashib qoladi.

| Foydalanish turi | Yetarli RAM | Qulay RAM |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Internet, hujjatlar, oʻqish | 8 GB | 16 GB |
| Dasturlash, dizayn | 16 GB | 32 GB |
| Video montaj, 3D, oʻyinlar | 16 GB | 32 GB va undan koʻp |

## Doimiy xotira

Doimiy xotira kompyuter oʻchiq boʻlganda ham fayllaringiz va ilovalaringizni saqlaydi. Uning uchta keng tarqalgan turi bor:

- **HDD** (qattiq disk) — aylanuvchi magnit disklar. Katta hajm uchun arzon, lekin sekin va zarbalarga sezgir.
- **SATA SSD** — harakatlanuvchi qismlari yoʻq va HDD dan bir necha barobar tez.
- **NVMe SSD** — bevosita ona plataga ulanadi (odatda *M.2* uyasiga) va eng tez keng tarqalgan variant hisoblanadi.

SSD butun kompyuterni tezroq his qildiradi: u bir necha soniyada ishga tushadi, ilovalar tez ochiladi. Koʻpchilik uchun SSD biroz tezroq protsessordan muhimroq.

## Ishlangan misol

Siz 50 MB hajmli fotosuratni muharrirda ochasiz. Surat **SSD** dan oʻqiladi, **RAM** ga yuklanadi, **CPU** muharrirning koʻrsatmalarini bajaradi, **GPU** filtr qoʻllashda yordam beradi va natija ekranda paydo boʻladi. Agar RAM deyarli toʻla boʻlsa, kompyuter maʼlumotlarni doimiy xotiraga qayta-qayta koʻchirishga majbur boʻladi va har bir bosish sekin bajariladi.

## Oʻzingiz sinab koʻring

Foydalanayotgan kompyuteringizning protsessori, RAMi va doimiy xotirasini toping:

- **Windows:** **Settings → System → About** hamda **Task Manager → Performance** (**Ctrl + Shift + Esc** ni bosing).
- **macOS:** **Apple menyusi → About This Mac**.

Yadrolar sonini, RAM hajmini hamda doimiy xotiraning turi va hajmini yozib oling.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar

- Protsessorni faqat GHz boʻyicha baholash. Yadrolar soni va protsessor avlodi ham shunchalik muhim.
- Koʻp doimiy xotira, lekin juda kam RAM sotib olish — natijada bir nechta ilova ochilganda kompyuter sekinlashadi.
- RAM va doimiy xotirani chalkashtirish. Telefon “128 GB” deb reklama qilinganda, bu RAM emas, doimiy xotira.

## Asosiy atamalar

- **CPU / yadro** — protsessor va uning mustaqil “ishchilaridan” biri.
- **Takt chastotasi (GHz)** — soniyadagi sikllar soni, milliardlarda.
- **RAM** — tezkor, vaqtinchalik ishchi xotira.
- **SSD / HDD / NVMe** — doimiy xotira turlari, eng tezidan (NVMe) eng sekiniga (HDD) qadar.

contents.body_md:
## Peripherals: everything you plug in

A **peripheral** is a device connected to a computer from outside: a keyboard, mouse, monitor, printer, headphones or an external drive. By the end of this lesson you will recognise the common ports and be able to read a computer's specification sheet with confidence.

## Common ports

| Port | What it is used for |
| --- | --- |
| **USB-A** | The classic rectangular USB: mice, keyboards, flash drives |
| **USB-C** | Small reversible connector for data, charging and often video |
| **HDMI** | Video and sound to a monitor, TV or projector |
| **Ethernet (RJ-45)** | Wired network connection — more stable than Wi-Fi |
| **3.5 mm audio** | Wired headphones and microphones |
| **SD card slot** | Memory cards from cameras and drones |

> [!WARNING]
> Every USB-C port has the same shape, but not the same abilities. One port may charge and show video, another may only transfer data slowly. Check the specification or the small symbols next to the port (for example, the lightning bolt for Thunderbolt) before you buy cables and adapters.

## Wireless connections

- **Wi-Fi** connects to the internet without cables. Newer standards (Wi-Fi 6, 6E and 7) are faster and cope better with many devices in one place.
- **Bluetooth** connects nearby accessories such as wireless headphones, keyboards and mice.

## Reading a specification sheet

Here is a typical laptop specification, explained line by line:

| Specification | What it tells you |
| --- | --- |
| 8-core processor, up to 4.5 GHz | Good for multitasking and heavier work; “up to” is the short burst speed |
| 16 GB RAM | Comfortable for studying, office work and programming |
| 512 GB NVMe SSD | Fast storage; about 476 GB will be shown as usable |
| 14-inch, 1920×1200 display | Screen size measured diagonally, and the number of pixels |
| Integrated graphics | Fine for everyday work; limited for 3D and games |
| 2× USB-C, 1× USB-A, HDMI | Plenty of connections without adapters |
| Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3 | Modern wireless standards |
| Battery up to 10 hours | Measured in light use; expect less in real life |

Why does 512 GB show as about 476 GB? Manufacturers count 1 GB as 1 000 000 000 bytes, while operating systems often count in units of 1 024. The operating system and recovery files also take some space.

## Matching a computer to a need

| Person | Focus on |
| --- | --- |
| Student writing and browsing | SSD, 8–16 GB RAM, a light laptop with good battery life |
| Video editor | Strong multi-core CPU, 32 GB RAM, large NVMe SSD, a dedicated GPU |
| Office worker | Reliable SSD, 16 GB RAM, good keyboard, enough ports for a monitor |

## Try it

Open the specification pages of two laptops sold in your area. For a student on a budget, decide which one you would choose, and write two sentences explaining why using the lines of the specification.

## Common mistakes

- Trusting “up to” numbers for battery life and speed as everyday values.
- Assuming every USB-C cable or port supports charging and video.
- Choosing a computer for its large storage while it has too little RAM.

## Key terms

- **Peripheral** — a device connected to the computer from outside.
- **Port** — a socket for connecting a cable.
- **USB-C** — a reversible connector whose abilities vary by device.
- **Specification (spec sheet)** — the list of a device's parts and features.

## Tashqi qurilmalar: ulanadigan hamma narsa

**Tashqi qurilma** (*peripheral*) — kompyuterga tashqaridan ulanadigan qurilma: klaviatura, sichqoncha, monitor, printer, quloqchin yoki tashqi disk. Dars oxirida keng tarqalgan portlarni taniysiz va kompyuterning texnik tavsifini ishonch bilan oʻqiy olasiz.

## Keng tarqalgan portlar

| Port | Nima uchun ishlatiladi |
| --- | --- |
| **USB-A** | Klassik toʻrtburchak USB: sichqoncha, klaviatura, fleshka |
| **USB-C** | Maʼlumot, quvvatlash va koʻpincha video uchun kichik, ikki tomonlama ulagich |
| **HDMI** | Monitor, televizor yoki proyektorga tasvir va ovoz uzatish |
| **Ethernet (RJ-45)** | Simli tarmoq ulanishi — Wi-Fi ga qaraganda barqarorroq |
| **3.5 mm audio** | Simli quloqchin va mikrofonlar |
| **SD karta uyasi** | Kamera va dronlardagi xotira kartalari |

> [!WARNING]
> Barcha USB-C portlar shakli bir xil, ammo imkoniyatlari har xil. Bir port quvvatlay oladi va tasvir chiqaradi, boshqasi esa faqat sekin maʼlumot uzatishi mumkin. Kabel va adapterlar sotib olishdan oldin texnik tavsifni yoki port yonidagi kichik belgilarni (masalan, Thunderbolt uchun chaqmoq belgisini) tekshiring.

## Simsiz ulanishlar

- **Wi-Fi** internetga simsiz ulanadi. Yangi standartlar (Wi-Fi 6, 6E va 7) tezroq va bir joydagi koʻplab qurilmalar bilan yaxshiroq ishlaydi.
- **Bluetooth** simsiz quloqchin, klaviatura va sichqoncha kabi yaqin atrofdagi qurilmalarni ulaydi.

## Texnik tavsifni oʻqish

Quyida odatiy noutbuk texnik tavsifi qatorma-qator tushuntirilgan:

| Tavsif | Nimani bildiradi |
| --- | --- |
| 8 yadroli protsessor, 4.5 GHz gacha | Bir vaqtda koʻp ish va ogʻirroq vazifalar uchun yaxshi; “gacha” — qisqa muddatli eng yuqori tezlik |
| 16 GB RAM | Oʻqish, ofis ishlari va dasturlash uchun qulay |
| 512 GB NVMe SSD | Tez doimiy xotira; foydalanish uchun taxminan 476 GB koʻrsatiladi |
| 14 dyuymli, 1920×1200 ekran | Diagonal boʻyicha oʻlchangan ekran hajmi va piksellar soni |
| Integratsiyalashgan grafika | Kundalik ishlar uchun yetarli; 3D va oʻyinlar uchun cheklangan |
| 2× USB-C, 1× USB-A, HDMI | Adaptersiz yetarlicha ulanish imkoniyati |
| Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3 | Zamonaviy simsiz standartlar |
| Batareya 10 soatgacha | Yengil foydalanishda oʻlchangan; amalda kamroq boʻladi |

Nega 512 GB taxminan 476 GB boʻlib koʻrinadi? Ishlab chiqaruvchilar 1 GB ni 1 000 000 000 bayt deb hisoblaydi, operatsion tizimlar esa koʻpincha 1 024 lik birliklarda hisoblaydi. Operatsion tizim va tiklash fayllari ham biroz joy egallaydi.

## Kompyuterni ehtiyojga moslash

| Kim uchun | Nimaga eʼtibor berish kerak |
| --- | --- |
| Matn yozadigan va internetdan foydalanadigan talaba | SSD, 8–16 GB RAM, batareyasi yaxshi yengil noutbuk |
| Video montajchi | Kuchli koʻp yadroli protsessor, 32 GB RAM, katta NVMe SSD, alohida videokarta |
| Ofis xodimi | Ishonchli SSD, 16 GB RAM, qulay klaviatura, monitor uchun yetarli portlar |

## Oʻzingiz sinab koʻring

Hududingizda sotiladigan ikkita noutbukning texnik tavsif sahifalarini oching. Byudjeti cheklangan talaba uchun qaysi birini tanlashingizni hal qiling va texnik tavsif qatorlariga tayanib, sababini ikki gap bilan yozing.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar

- Batareya va tezlik boʻyicha “gacha” raqamlarini kundalik qiymat deb ishonish.
- Har qanday USB-C kabel yoki port quvvatlash va tasvir uzatishni qoʻllab-quvvatlaydi deb oʻylash.
- RAMi juda kam boʻlsa-da, doimiy xotirasi katta boʻlgani uchun kompyuterni tanlash.

## Asosiy atamalar

- **Tashqi qurilma** — kompyuterga tashqaridan ulanadigan qurilma.
- **Port** — kabel ulash uchun uya.
- **USB-C** — imkoniyatlari qurilmaga qarab farq qiladigan ikki tomonlama ulagich.
- **Texnik tavsif** (*specification*) — qurilmaning qismlari va imkoniyatlari roʻyxati.

## Where software should come from

In this lesson you will learn how to install and remove programs without picking up malware or unwanted extras. Safe sources, in order of preference:

1. **The official app store** of your system — Microsoft Store on Windows, the App Store on macOS. Apps there are checked before they are listed.
2. **The developer's official website** — for example, videolan.org for VLC or python.org for Python. Type the address yourself or check it carefully.
3. **A package manager** — a tool that installs software from trusted lists. You will meet these in later courses.

> [!WARNING]
> “Cracked” or pirated software is one of the most common ways malware spreads, and using it is illegal. If a program costs money, look for an official free version, an education discount or a free alternative.

## Red flags on download pages

- Several large “Download” buttons — usually advertisements leading elsewhere.
- A file that does not match what you expect (for example, a 1 MB file for a 300 MB program).
- A site that is not the developer's own domain.

## Installing on Windows

Windows installers are usually `.exe` or `.msi` files. When you run one:

- A **User Account Control** prompt asks whether the app may make changes. Allow it only for software you trust.
- Read every screen. Installers sometimes offer extra software such as browser toolbars — **untick these offers**.
- Choose the default install folder unless you have a reason to change it.

## Installing on macOS

Mac apps usually come as `.dmg` files. Open the file and drag the app into the **Applications** folder. If macOS warns that the developer cannot be verified, stop and check where the file came from instead of bypassing the warning.

## Keeping software updated

Updates fix security problems as well as adding features. Turn on automatic updates where available, and install updates for your browser and operating system promptly.

## Removing software

- **Windows:** **Settings → Apps → Installed apps**, choose the app, then **Uninstall**.
- **macOS:** drag the app from **Applications** to the **Trash**. Some apps include their own uninstaller — use it if there is one.

Uninstalling programs you no longer use frees space and removes software that would otherwise need updates.

## Try it

Install a free program from its official website — for example, the VLC media player from videolan.org. Open it once, then uninstall it using the steps above.

## Common mistakes

- Clicking the first search result, which is often an advertisement.
- Clicking **Next** on every installer screen without reading it.
- Leaving old, unused programs installed and out of date.

## Key terms

- **Installer** — a file that copies a program onto your computer and sets it up.
- **Malware** — software designed to harm you or your computer.
- **Uninstall** — to remove a program properly.
- **Update** — a new version that fixes problems or adds features.

## Dasturlar qayerdan olinishi kerak

Bu darsda dasturlarni zararli yoki keraksiz qoʻshimchalarsiz oʻrnatish va oʻchirishni oʻrganasiz. Xavfsiz manbalar, afzallik tartibida:

1. Tizimingizning **rasmiy ilovalar doʻkoni** — Windowsda Microsoft Store, macOSda App Store. U yerdagi ilovalar roʻyxatga kiritilishidan oldin tekshiriladi.
2. **Ishlab chiqaruvchining rasmiy sayti** — masalan, VLC uchun videolan.org yoki Python uchun python.org. Manzilni oʻzingiz yozing yoki diqqat bilan tekshiring.
3. **Paketlar menejeri** — dasturlarni ishonchli roʻyxatlardan oʻrnatadigan vosita. Ular bilan keyingi kurslarda tanishasiz.

> [!WARNING]
> “Buzilgan” (*cracked*) yoki qaroqchilik yoʻli bilan tarqatilgan dasturlar zararli dasturlar tarqalishining eng keng tarqalgan yoʻllaridan biri, ulardan foydalanish esa qonunga xilof. Agar dastur pullik boʻlsa, uning rasmiy bepul versiyasini, taʼlim uchun chegirmani yoki bepul muqobilini qidiring.

## Yuklab olish sahifalaridagi xavf belgilari

- Bir nechta katta “Download” tugmasi — odatda boshqa joyga olib boradigan reklamalar.
- Kutilganga mos kelmaydigan fayl (masalan, 300 MB lik dastur oʻrniga 1 MB lik fayl).
- Ishlab chiqaruvchining oʻz domeni boʻlmagan sayt.

## Windowsda oʻrnatish

Windows oʻrnatuvchilari odatda `.exe` yoki `.msi` fayllari boʻladi. Ulardan birini ishga tushirganingizda:

- **User Account Control** (foydalanuvchi hisoblarini boshqarish) oynasi ilovaga oʻzgartirishlar kiritishga ruxsat berish-bermaslikni soʻraydi. Faqat ishonchli dasturlarga ruxsat bering.
- Har bir oynani oʻqing. Oʻrnatuvchilar baʼzan brauzer panellari kabi qoʻshimcha dasturlarni taklif qiladi — **bu takliflardan belgini olib tashlang**.
- Biror sababingiz boʻlmasa, standart oʻrnatish papkasini tanlang.

## macOSda oʻrnatish

Mac ilovalari odatda `.dmg` fayllari koʻrinishida keladi. Faylni oching va ilovani **Applications** papkasiga torting. Agar macOS ishlab chiquvchini tasdiqlab boʻlmasligi haqida ogohlantirsa, ogohlantirishni chetlab oʻtish oʻrniga toʻxtang va fayl qayerdan kelganini tekshiring.

## Dasturlarni yangilab turish

Yangilanishlar yangi imkoniyatlar qoʻshish bilan birga xavfsizlik muammolarini ham tuzatadi. Imkon boʻlgan joyda avtomatik yangilanishni yoqing, brauzer va operatsion tizim yangilanishlarini kechiktirmasdan oʻrnating.

## Dasturlarni oʻchirish

- **Windows:** **Settings → Apps → Installed apps** boʻlimida ilovani tanlang, soʻngra **Uninstall** ni bosing.
- **macOS:** ilovani **Applications** papkasidan **Trash** (savat) ga torting. Baʼzi ilovalarning oʻz oʻchirish dasturi boʻladi — agar bor boʻlsa, undan foydalaning.

Foydalanmaydigan dasturlarni oʻchirish joy boʻshatadi va aks holda yangilab turish kerak boʻladigan dasturlardan xalos qiladi.

## Oʻzingiz sinab koʻring

Bepul dasturni uning rasmiy saytidan oʻrnating — masalan, VLC media pleyerini videolan.org saytidan. Uni bir marta oching, soʻngra yuqoridagi qadamlar bilan oʻchiring.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar

- Koʻpincha reklama boʻlib chiqadigan birinchi qidiruv natijasini bosish.
- Oʻrnatuvchining har bir oynasida oʻqimasdan **Next** ni bosish.
- Eski, foydalanilmaydigan dasturlarni yangilamasdan oʻrnatilgan holda qoldirish.

## Asosiy atamalar

- **Oʻrnatuvchi** (*installer*) — dasturni kompyuteringizga koʻchiradigan va sozlaydigan fayl.
- **Zararli dastur** (*malware*) — sizga yoki kompyuteringizga zarar yetkazish uchun yaratilgan dastur.
- **Oʻchirish** (*uninstall*) — dasturni toʻgʻri usulda olib tashlash.
- **Yangilanish** (*update*) — muammolarni tuzatadigan yoki imkoniyat qoʻshadigan yangi versiya.

## Why backups matter

Sooner or later, every device fails, gets lost or is stolen — and people delete the wrong file by accident. In this lesson you will learn how to keep copies so that losing a device never means losing your work.

Common causes of data loss:

- A storage drive fails, often without warning.
- A laptop or phone is lost or stolen.
- A file is deleted or overwritten by mistake.
- **Ransomware** — malware that locks your files and demands payment.

## The 3-2-1 rule

Professionals follow a simple rule:

- **3** copies of important data (the original and two backups),
- on **2** different kinds of storage (for example, your laptop and an external drive),
- with **1** copy kept **off-site** (in the cloud or at another location).

If the house floods, the off-site copy survives. If the cloud account is locked, the external drive still has your files.

## Cloud storage

Services such as Google Drive, iCloud and OneDrive keep your files on their servers and make them available on all your devices. Most offer some free space.

> [!WARNING]
> **Sync is not a backup.** A synced folder copies every change everywhere — including deletions. If you delete a file on your laptop, it disappears from the cloud too. Use the service's version history or a separate backup to protect against this.

## Built-in backup tools

- **Windows:** **Settings → Accounts → Windows Backup**, and **File History** for keeping older versions of files on an external drive.
- **macOS:** **Time Machine** backs up the whole Mac to an external drive automatically.

## Test your backups

A backup you have never restored is only a hope. Every few months, restore one file from your backup to check that it works.

## A worked example

Aziza is a student with essays, photos and project files:

| Copy | Where | Kind of storage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Original | Laptop SSD | Internal drive |
| Backup 1 | External drive, Time Machine weekly | External drive |
| Backup 2 | Cloud folder with version history | Off-site |

## Try it

Make a table like Aziza's for your own important files. Then switch on the built-in backup tool on your computer, or choose a cloud service.

## Common mistakes

- Treating a synced folder as a backup.
- Keeping the backup drive plugged in all the time, where ransomware can reach it too.
- Never testing whether files can actually be restored.

## Key terms

- **Backup** — a separate copy kept so you can restore lost data.
- **3-2-1 rule** — three copies, two kinds of storage, one off-site.
- **Sync** — keeping the same files identical on several devices.
- **Ransomware** — malware that locks files and demands payment.

## Zaxira nusxalar nega muhim

Ertami-kechmi har qanday qurilma buziladi, yoʻqoladi yoki oʻgʻirlanadi — odamlar esa notoʻgʻri faylni bilmasdan oʻchirib yuboradi. Bu darsda qurilmani yoʻqotish hech qachon ishingizni yoʻqotish degani boʻlmasligi uchun nusxalarni qanday saqlashni oʻrganasiz.

Maʼlumot yoʻqolishining keng tarqalgan sabablari:

- Doimiy xotira qurilmasi koʻpincha ogohlantirishsiz ishdan chiqadi.
- Noutbuk yoki telefon yoʻqoladi yoki oʻgʻirlanadi.
- Fayl xato tufayli oʻchirib yuboriladi yoki ustidan yoziladi.
- **Ransomware** (toʻlov talab qiluvchi dastur) — fayllaringizni qulflab, pul talab qiladigan zararli dastur.

## 3-2-1 qoidasi

Mutaxassislar oddiy qoidaga amal qiladi:

- muhim maʼlumotlarning **3** nusxasi (asl nusxa va ikkita zaxira),
- **2** xil turdagi xotirada (masalan, noutbukingiz va tashqi disk),
- **1** nusxa **boshqa joyda** (bulutda yoki boshqa manzilda) saqlanadi.

Agar uyni suv bossa, boshqa joydagi nusxa saqlanib qoladi. Agar bulut hisobi bloklansa, fayllaringiz tashqi diskda baribir boʻladi.

## Bulutli xotira

Google Drive, iCloud va OneDrive kabi xizmatlar fayllaringizni oʻz serverlarida saqlaydi va ularni barcha qurilmalaringizda ochish imkonini beradi. Aksariyati maʼlum hajmdagi joyni bepul beradi.

> [!WARNING]
> **Sinxronlash — zaxira nusxa emas.** Sinxronlangan papka har bir oʻzgarishni hamma joyga koʻchiradi — oʻchirishlarni ham. Noutbukingizda faylni oʻchirsangiz, u bulutdan ham yoʻqoladi. Bunga qarshi xizmatning versiyalar tarixidan yoki alohida zaxira nusxadan foydalaning.

## Oʻrnatilgan zaxiralash vositalari

- **Windows:** **Settings → Accounts → Windows Backup** hamda fayllarning eski versiyalarini tashqi diskda saqlash uchun **File History**.
- **macOS:** **Time Machine** butun Mac kompyuterni tashqi diskka avtomatik zaxiralaydi.

## Zaxira nusxalaringizni tekshiring

Hech qachon tiklab koʻrilmagan zaxira nusxa — shunchaki umid. Har bir necha oyda zaxira nusxadan bitta faylni tiklab, uning ishlashini tekshiring.

## Ishlangan misol

Aziza — insholar, fotosuratlar va loyiha fayllari bor talaba:

| Nusxa | Qayerda | Xotira turi |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Asl nusxa | Noutbuk SSD si | Ichki disk |
| 1-zaxira | Tashqi disk, haftada bir marta Time Machine | Tashqi disk |
| 2-zaxira | Versiyalar tarixi bor bulut papkasi | Boshqa joyda |

## Oʻzingiz sinab koʻring

Muhim fayllaringiz uchun Azizanikiga oʻxshash jadval tuzing. Keyin kompyuteringizdagi oʻrnatilgan zaxiralash vositasini yoqing yoki bulut xizmatini tanlang.

## Keng tarqalgan xatolar

- Sinxronlangan papkani zaxira nusxa deb hisoblash.
- Zaxira diskni doim ulangan holda qoldirish — u yerga ransomware ham yetib boradi.
- Fayllarni haqiqatan ham tiklash mumkinligini hech qachon tekshirmaslik.

## Asosiy atamalar

- **Zaxira nusxa** (*backup*) — yoʻqolgan maʼlumotni tiklash uchun alohida saqlanadigan nusxa.
- **3-2-1 qoidasi** — uchta nusxa, ikki xil xotira, bittasi boshqa joyda.
- **Sinxronlash** (*sync*) — bir nechta qurilmadagi fayllarni bir xil holatda saqlash.
- **Ransomware** — fayllarni qulflab, pul talab qiladigan zararli dastur.
